checks: Actual exported schematic nets match board generation
All 256 bus bytes displayed without inversion
ALU J4/J6 compatibility when ALU project is present
Only receiver inputs connected to shared bus; no on-board active bus driver

No sample-and-hold: LED visibility at speed depends on data duty cycle
